evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list gives CARDC’s other names as Unit 63820, the 29th Testing and Training Base and the Academy of Military Science Aerodynamics Testing Base, and a 2024 CASI study identifies it as a PLA research institute with a major part in the PLA’s hypersonic weapons work. In hypersonics papers from 2012 to 2020 it was the PLA institution that US researchers co-authored with most often after NUDT.

CASI notes that sources differ on whether CARDC reports to the Academy of Military Science or to the PLA Strategic Support Force; one of its names on Canada’s list calls it an Academy of Military Science testing base.
